claimMap.exactSentence: This page is for people in Darfield looking for NHS Pharmacy First consultations.
You can decide whether to contact the local pharmacy for assessment of eligible common conditions.
Yorkshire Pharmacy & Health Clinic is located in Darfield at 91 Snape Hill Rd, Barnsley S73 9LR.
The pharmacy is situated within Darfield itself, making it part of the immediate local healthcare landscape.
If you think Pharmacy First may be suitable for your symptoms, you can call 01226 210477 before visiting to check how consultations are being arranged.
How close is the pharmacy to me in Darfield?
The pharmacy is located within Darfield, around 0.5 km from the centre of the area.
When should I use another healthcare route?
You should seek urgent medical care for severe or emergency symptoms, or if the pharmacist advises referral after your consultation.
What should I bring to my Pharmacy First consultation?
Bring details of your symptoms and any medicines you are currently taking to help the pharmacist assess your needs.
Contact the pharmacy to discuss your symptoms or arrange an appointment.
